page.layout: One column of verse, set in italic, with stanzas separated by spaces. Running head at top right, page number at top left. Catchword alone at bottom right. Faint show-through of the facing page in the right margin, not transcribed.

p.i: Deus tetendit arcum, Deprompsit & pharetra Truces grauì[?] sagittas Illisq; gestit usque Me, ceu scopum ferire.
Hac illius potente Vibrata tela dextra Hærent adacta carni: Renesque sauciarunt, Et intimas medullas.
Suis ubique gentes Scurrilibus profestæ[?] Me risibus lacessunt. Fabella sum, & peremnæ[?] Vulgi per ora carmen.
Sardoniisque mensas Herbis amariores Mihi reponit usque, Inebriansque succos Absynthij propinat.
Minutulaque mixta Meis cibis arena Dentes terunt retusos. Pulvis per omne sparsum

page.notes: Printed "Puluis" in the last line is kept as printed ("Puluis"). Doubtful readings: "grauì" (the i may be a dotted i or a mark), "profestæ" (the long-s ligature in "profestæ"), and "peremnæ" (the final letter may be æ or ę). Initial "Quem" is partly obscured by the top edge. Vowel u/v corrected only where the vowel is u (usque, Vulgi, Vibrata). Faint show-through from the facing page is ignored.
